messages:
carmen_privacy: FYI — incoming EU DSAR. Requester wants full deletion of chat transcripts + associated embeddings. Data locations: gs://redwood-eu-chat-backups (snapshots) and our vector-index (eu-region). Embeddings were encrypted with a customer-managed GCP KMS key: projects/customer-987/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key.

carmen_privacy: Qs: (1) what's the minimal verification we should accept for this requester, (2) can we perform deletion if we don't have long-lived decrypt rights to their CMK, and (3) any retention-exception/legal-hold checks to run first?

ben_legal: For identity: we need account_id + email + supportive evidence (recent activity or session proof). Prefer portal-authenticated confirmation (signed JWT) rather than email alone.

ben_legal: Also check lit/comm/legal_hold flag for that customer. If legal hold -> STOP.

maria_sre: Technical: snapshots are encrypted at rest with that CMK. Our current svc-account doesn't have decrypt on the customer's key. Without Decrypt we can't read snapshot blobs to scrub them.

maria_sre: Options: (a) customer grants a short-lived IAM binding to our svc-account; (b) customer rewraps/decrypts on their side and provides data; (c) if embeddings are stored in vector index with opaque ciphertext we can delete index entries without decrypt depending on storage layer.

alice_engsec: Prefer not to ask customers to grant broad access. Proposed flow: 1) verify requester via portal-signed JWT (one-time), 2) mint one-time deletion token scoped to customer_id + dsar_id, 3) spawn ephemeral worker with narrowly scoped IAM role (KMS.Decrypt on that single key resource) to perform deletion, 4) rotate that ephemeral role after operation. All steps fully audit-logged. :lock:

dan_platform: +1 to ephemeral worker. Important: correlate all logs with dsar_request_id and include cryptoKey resource in audit logs. We should add a dsar_request_id field to trace across services.

carmen_privacy: Example verification text for portal flow I can expose to the requester: "Please confirm your identity by signing in to your account and clicking 'Confirm DSAR' — this will generate a one-time deletion token valid for 15 minutes."

carmen_privacy: Here's sample API call the worker would run (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://privapi.internal/v1/erase \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONE_TIME_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"cust-987","dsar_id":"dsar-2025-03-21-01","delete_embeddings":true,"snapshots":["gs://redwood-eu-chat-backups/snap-2025-02-18-03"]}'
```

alice_engsec: For RBAC: I'll draft a new role 'roles/redwood.privacyDeleteWorker' that is constrained to resource: `projects/customer-987/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key` and allowed methods: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt, storage.objects.delete, vectorservice.index.delete. Add an IAM condition limiting to time window and dsar_request_id in request arg.

maria_sre: I'll prep the runbook for the ephemeral worker (how to validate the one-time token, backoff/retry if KMS returns PERMISSION_DENIED, safe failure modes if objects partially deleted). Also check vector-index soft-delete semantics (we may need to run compaction).

dan_platform: I'll update our audit pipeline to surface: dsar_request_id, actor_service_account, cryptoKey resource name, object list, and result (success/failure). Need this before we run anything for traceability.

ben_legal: Reminder: if the customer requests proof of deletion, we must provide an evidence bundle (deletion log + dsar_request_id + worker id + timestamps). Keep retention of that evidence per legal rules.

carmen_privacy: Confirmed: no active legal hold for this customer. Proceeding. Owners: alice_engsec -> RBAC PR, maria_sre -> runbook + op steps, dan_platform -> audit changes, myself -> portal one-time token UI + DSAR tracker entry. Tentative ETA: RBAC PR by EOD, runbook by EOD+1, audit schema by EOW.

keystore-bot: NOTE: Keystore access review requested for projects/customer-987. Auto-ticket created: KMS-REQ-4021.

deploy-bot: PR submitted -> infra/iam#4325 (adds roles/redwood.privacyDeleteWorker).

alice_engsec: I'll include IAM condition example in the PR. Example condition: `request.time < timestamp("2025-03-22T00:00:00Z") && request.auth.claims.dsar_id == "dsar-2025-03-21-01"`.

carmen_privacy: Great — I'll update the DSAR tracker and reply to requester with portal link. Will post after RBAC merge. Thanks everyone. :pray:
